detail.title: CP-UNR-4K5322-FI
features: Up to 32 channel IP camera input
Max. 384 Mbps Incoming/ Recording/ Outgoing bandwidth
Instastream, H.265, Smart H.264+, H.264, MJPEG codec decoding
AI by Recorder: 2 Channel face detection or recognition, 4 Channel perimeter protection,  8 Channel IMD+.
AI by camera: Face detection and recognition, Perimeter protection, IMD+, Metadata,  ANPR, Stereo analysis, Heat map, and people counting.
Support 2 SATA HDDs up to 16TB Each, 2 USB Ports (1 USB 3.0)

General.Video Output: 1 Channel VGA, 1 Channel HDMI video output.                              Heterogeneous video source output for HDMI and VGA Supports 4K display
General.Decoding Capability: AI disabled: 2 Channel 32MP@20 fps, 2 Channel 24MP@20 fps, 4 Channel 16MP@30 fps,        5 Channel 12MP@30fps, 8 Channel 8MP@30 fps, 12 Channel 5MP@30fps, 16 Channel  4MP@30 fps, 32 Channel 1080p@30fps  AI enabled: 1 Channel 32MP@20 fps, 1 Channel 24MP@20 fps, 2 Channel 16MP@30 fps,        4 Channel 12MP@30 fps, 4 Channel 8MP@30 fps, 8 Channel 5MP@30 fps, 12 Channel             4MP@30 fps, 24 Channel 1080p@30fps
General.AI by NVR: Face detection, Face recognition, Perimeter protection, IMD+
General.AI by Camera: Face detection, Face recognition, Video metadata (Human, Motor vehicles, and non-motor  vehicles), Perimeter protection, IMD+, Stereo analysis, Crowd distribution, People counting,  ANPR, Vehicle density, Heat map
General.Network Bandwidth: AI disabled: 384 Mbps Incoming, 384 Mbps Recording and 384 Mbps Outgoing                               AI enabled: 200 Mbps Incoming, 200 Mbps Recording and 200 Mbps Outgoing
General.Perimeter Performance AI by NVR (Number: 4 Channels, 10 IVS rules for each channel
General.Perimeter Performance of AI by Camera (N: Human and vehicle detection on all channels, supporting up to 16 targets per second
General.Face Attributes: Gender, Age group, Glasses, Expressions, Face mask, Beard
General.Face Detection Performance of AI by NVR: 2 Channels (up to 12 face images/s each channel)
General.Face Database Capacity: Up to 20 face databases with 20,000 images, with a total capacity of 2.5 G. Name, Gender,  Birthday, Address, Credential type, Credential No., Countries & Regions and state can be  added to each face image
General.Face Recognition Performance of AI by NV: 1.16 Channel FD (by camera) + FR (by recorder), image stream: 16 face images/s 2.2 Channel FD (by recorder) + FR (by recorder), video stream: 12 face images/s
General.IMD+ by NVR: 8 Channels: Secondary filtering for human and motor vehicle, reducing false alarms caused  by leaves, rain and lighting condition change
General.IMD By Camera: Human and vehicle detection on all channels, supporting up to 32 targets per second
General.Human Attributes: Top color, Top type, Bottom color, Bottom type, Hat, Bag, Age, Gender and umbrella
General.Motor Vehicle Attributes: License plate, Plate color, Vehicle body, Vehicle model, Vehicle logo, Calling, Seatbelt,  Vehicle interior, Vehicle registration location
General.Non-motor Vehicle Attributes: Vehicle model, Vehicle color, Number of persons, Helmet
General.ANPR by Camera (Number of Channels): Human and vehicle detection on all channels, Supporting up to 8 targets per second
General.License Plate Database Capacity: 1. Create up to 20,000 plate numbers  2. Blocklist and allow list
General.Intelligent Alarm: Face detection, Perimeter protection, Face recognition, Video metadata (Human, Motor    vehicles, and non-motor vehicles), IMD+, Stereo analysis, Crowd distribution, People  counting, ANPR, Vehicle density, Heat map
General.Abnormality Alarm: Camera offline, Storage error, Disk full, IP conflict, MAC conflict, Login lock, Abnormal  behaviour of fan, Cyber security exception
General.General Alarm: Motion detection, Privacy masking, Local alarm
General.Alarm Linkage: Record, Snapshot (panoramic), Local alarm output, IPC external alarm output, Access  controller, Audio, Buzzer, Log, Preset, Email
General.Hard Disk: 2 SATA ports, up to 16TB. The maximum HDD capacity varies with environment temperature
General.Record Mode: General, Motion detection, Intelligent, Alarm, POS
General.Playback Mode: Instant playback, General playback, Event playback, Tag playback, Smart playback (face  and motion detection)
General.Interface Ports: 2 USB Ports (1 Rear USB 3.0 , 1 Front USB 2.0 ), 1 RS232, 1 RS485
General.Protocols: HTTP, HTTPS, TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, RTSP, UDP, SNMP, NTP, DHCP, DNS, SMTP, UPnP, IP Filter,  PPPoE, FTP, DDNS, Alarm Server, IP Search, Multicast, InstaOn, Auto Connect, ONVIF (Profile T,  Profile S, Profile G), CGI, SDK
